name: Trouble in Twin Lakes
description: Two weeks ago Aldra, the beloved butcher of Isthmus Town, vanished without a trace. Some days later a local teen reported seeing a man swallowed up by the earth near Deadmill. Others have also gone missing. Now the townsfolk are left wondering: who might be next?
blurb: A vanished butcher and a man swallowed by the earth: two mysteries in a fading lake town.
source: This module uses content from CAS-1: Trouble in Twin Lakes by Yochai Gal; see CREDITS.md.
body:
Sandbox mystery. Let the players choose either hook or both, and let their preparations matter. The region is dangerous at night.

The two mysteries are unrelated, though they share people and places.

The Return of Vuk: six months ago Fasha, Reeve Trellis's right hand, heard Vuk beneath Bone Sump and freed her, gaining the Eye of Vuk. Two weeks ago Aldra saw the Reeve carrying bags from the Stuffed Inn cellar and followed him. Fasha ambushed Aldra and fed his heart to Vuk; the Reeve knows Fasha did it but stays silent from fear and selfishness. Vuk now demands more hearts; every other evening Fasha kidnaps a victim for the Temple of the Fungal Lizards, and the heart is consumed the following morning.

The Swallowed Man: one week ago Jandy fell into quicksand at Deadmill and died. The Echo Spark brought him back without the memory, and he repeats the death. Annafranax hid a Wisp Lamp to feed on his deaths; two days after the adventure begins, on the night of the next full moon, she returns to throw it into the quicksand and open a Gate to the Roots. Drum witnessed one death.

Run the adventure with Cairn 2e's core Backgrounds and Dungeon Exploration procedures. Its sites are too far apart for the Wilderness Procedures to be much use; roll on the encounters table instead. The Victim schedule rule sets the nights Vuk feeds.

Endings: the outcome rules in rules.json are the four possible conclusions.

start.hooks:
- The Tideborn have agreed to pay the party a sum of 750gp for determining Aldra’s whereabouts. A bonus of 250gp is to be paid in the event that the man’s body is recovered and returned to a Tideborn acolyte for proper burial. They are to meet with Flavia at the Butcher in Isthmus Town before they begin their search.
- The Cities are offering 200gp apiece to anyone who can help locate Jandy, a tithingman who was meant to return days ago with the latest tithe. The party will only be rewarded if the tithe is returned intact and accounted for. They are to meet with Reeve Trellis at the Stuffed Inn before they begin their search.
